info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Underwriting Update API
info.description: The Underwriting Update API facilitates the modification of existing underwriting records within the banking sales system. This endpoint allows users to adjust various attributes associated with a specific underwriting, enhancing the accuracy and relevance of underwriting data. Typical consumers include banking professionals, compliance officers, and risk analysts who need to update underwriting conditions based on evolving criteria. By streamlining the update process, this API supports better risk management and improved decision-making in financial operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific sales underwriting resource identified by its ID. Be sure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to successfully apply the changes.
